subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal Graph media fallback be enabled automatically when no media is extracted, or stay default-off behind a new channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback option while the channel URL fixes land?
rationale: The current gate avoids noisy Graph lookups for mention-only HTML, but Teams can omit attachment IDs for real uploaded files; the default affects existing deployments through Graph call volume, permissions expectations, diagnostics, and message-delivery behavior.

options.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
options.body: Keep existing deployments unchanged and let operators enable extra Graph message reads for group-chat/channel attachment recovery after documenting the required permissions and cost.

options.title: Automatic non-personal fallback
options.body: Relax the gate for all non-personal HTML activities with no resolved media so attachments work without new config, accepting extra Graph reads and possible mention-only diagnostics.

options.title: Combine the active fixes
options.body: Ask the linked branches to converge so channel aadGroupId/reply URL fixes and the group-chat fallback policy land with one compatibility story.

recommendation.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
recommendation.body: Keep existing deployments unchanged and let operators enable extra Graph message reads for group-chat/channel attachment recovery after documenting the required permissions and cost.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent merged ownership signal across msteams inbound-media and channel delivery, and the remaining choice is a compatibility/product default decision.
